# MIQ Enterprises LLC (MIQ | MIQ LLC Wiki | miqllcwiki.com)

> MIQ Enterprises LLC (also known as MIQ, MIQ LLC, MIQ Enterprises, MIQ LLC Wiki, or miqllcwiki.com) is an international digital services and technology solutions company providing worldwide Wikipedia consulting and digital growth services for clients in the United States and worldwide.

## What MIQ LLC Wiki / miqllcwiki.com does
MIQ Enterprises LLC (MIQ LLC Wiki, miqllcwiki.com) helps businesses, executives, brands, and organizations with credibility, visibility, and digital growth. Core offerings include worldwide Wikipedia consulting, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), website development, online reputation management, branding, and business technology solutions.

## Services
- **Worldwide Wikipedia consulting**: Wikipedia notability assessment, independent reliable source research, citation research, neutral drafting guidance, Wikipedia article writing guidance, Wikipedia editing support, Articles for Creation (AfC) process guidance, conflict-of-interest/paid-contribution disclosure guidance, and Wikipedia page maintenance recommendations for company, brand, and biography subjects. MIQ Enterprises LLC does **not** guarantee Wikipedia publication, approval, or retention.
- **SEO, AEO & GEO**: technical SEO, content strategy, search intent, entity clarity, structured data guidance, AI-search visibility, and digital marketing.
- **Website development**: business websites, WordPress, e-commerce, landing pages, redesign, and maintenance.
- **Online reputation management**: ethical brand visibility and credibility strategy.
- **Branding and creative solutions**: identity, design, and marketing assets.
- **Business and technology solutions**: automation, AI integration guidance, lead generation, and digital consulting.
